stock.description: Le Saunda Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily focused on the trade and retail of footwear and accessories across Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau. The company's activities span the full product lifecycle, from designing and developing to manufacturing and selling a diverse range of ladies' and men's shoes, handbags, and fashion accessories. These are marketed under its brand portfolio, which features names such as le saunda, le saunda MEN, LINEA ROSA, PITTI DONNA, and CNE. Customers can purchase products through its extensive network of 389 stores, comprising 353 company-owned outlets and 36 franchised locations, as well as via its online sales platforms. Beyond its core retail business, Le Saunda is also involved in property ownership, offers management services, manages and licenses its trademarks, and engages in the wholesale trading of shoes. Established in 1977, the company's headquarters are located in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
